snippet.title: Sneak & Snitch | Official Trailer (Coming Soon on Steam)
snippet.description:
Sneak & Snitch is a 4 to 8 player social deduction game set in a museum. The thieves hide among the visitors, paint their own forgeries and swap them for the real paintings. One player is the guard, riding a Segway through the halls and hunting them. When time runs out, a report shows exactly who fooled whom.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5051250/Sneak__Snitch/

#SneakAndSnitch #indiegame #socialdeduction
